drivingQuestion: Why does the verse read of which I have spoken rather than of which You have spoken?
outcomeNote: Two answers to the wording difficulty stand side by side; neither is refuted or preferred.

segments.he: ״וַתְּדַבֵּר אֲלֵיהֶם אַרְבֶּה אֶת זַרְעֲכֶם כְּכוֹכְבֵי הַשָּׁמָיִם וְכׇל הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר אָמַרְתִּי״, הַאי ״אֲשֶׁר אָמַרְתִּי״, ״אֲשֶׁר אָמַרְתָּ״ מִיבְּעֵי לֵיהּ!
segments.en: In this verse, Moses continues: «“And You said to them: I will make your offspring as numerous as the stars of heaven, and all this land of which I have spoken» I will give to your offspring that they shall inherit it forever.” The Gemara clarifies a puzzling phrase in this verse. «That» phrase «of which I have spoken, it should» have said: «Of which You have spoken,» as Moses is referring to God’s promise to the forefathers.

segments.he: אָמַר רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר: עַד כָּאן דִּבְרֵי תַלְמִיד, מִכָּאן וְאֵילָךְ — דִּבְרֵי הָרַב. וְרַבִּי שְׁמוּאֵל בַּר נַחְמָנִי אָמַר: אֵלּוּ וָאֵלּוּ דִּבְרֵי תַלְמִיד, אֶלָּא כָּךְ אָמַר מֹשֶׁה לִפְנֵי הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא: רִבּוֹנוֹ שֶׁל עוֹלָם, דְּבָרִים שֶׁאָמַרְתָּ לִי ״לֵךְ אֱמוֹר לָהֶם לְיִשְׂרָאֵל״ בִּשְׁמִי, הָלַכְתִּי וְאָמַרְתִּי לָהֶם בִּשְׁמֶךָ. עַכְשָׁו מָה אֲנִי אוֹמֵר לָהֶם?
segments.en: «Rabbi Elazar said: To this» point, the verse cites «the words of the student,» Moses; «from this point,» and all this land of which I have spoken, the verse cites «the words of the Master,» God. «And Rabbi Shmuel bar Naḥmani said: These and those are the words of the student;» Moses spoke the entire verse. «Rather, Moses said before the Holy One, Blessed be He: Master of the Universe, those matters which You told me to go and say to Israel in My name, I went and told» it «to them in Your name.» I have already told Israel of God’s promise to the forefathers. «Now what do I say to them?»

moves.summary: the first person אמרתי is wrong: Moses is quoting God's promise, so it should read אמרת
moves.about: the verse should have said אשר אמרת, since Moses is quoting God's own promise to the forefathers

moves.cueHe: אמר רבי אלעזר: עד כאן דברי תלמיד
moves.summary: the verse switches speakers: student up to there, Master from there on
moves.about: up to that phrase the verse quotes the student, Moses; from there on the Master, God

moves.cueHe: ורבי שמואל בר נחמני אמר: אלו ואלו דברי תלמיד
moves.summary: all of it is Moses speaking: he had already delivered the promise in God's name and now asks what to say
moves.about: the whole verse is the student's words, and אשר אמרתי reports what Moses himself already told Israel
